name: Portable generator
description: A small petrol generator in an open tube frame, with two outlets on its panel. Runs on gasoline.
notes: power_supply is a new quality name. The three variants share this model as the brief asks, but they weigh 150 to 536 kg against 22 kg and fill 420 to 1000 L against 68 L, so drawn at this size they read as toys; a larger skid-mounted generator model would suit them.

name: Upright freezer
description: A waist-high household freezer with one door. Keeps food frozen. Needs mains power.
notes: Modelled upright rather than as a chest so it differs from the display freezer; 0.6 by 0.64 by 0.93 m matches the reference volume. freezing is a new quality name. A placed appliance; the size is only a placeholder.

name: Fridge
description: A household fridge with a small freezer compartment above. Keeps food cold. Needs mains power.
notes: refrigeration is a new quality name; the freezer compartment could also bring freezing 1 if the refactor wants it. A placed appliance; the size is only a placeholder.

name: Chest display freezer
description: A long shop chest freezer with two sliding glass lids. Holds a lot of frozen food. Needs mains power.
notes: Usage is empty because no shop or retail usage tag exists. Its box is 1.8 times the reference volume because the reference counts the packed cabinet, not the outer box; the 1.86 m length and mass match. Stock is drawn inside under the glass. A placed appliance; the size is only a placeholder.
